cause: The Ghost transition changed scoped gates_v2.py and test_gates_v2.py, invalidating the prior g1-ci fingerprint.
decision: Revalidate g1-ci only for the tested Ghost gate-definition transition. Preserve existing SSO and authorization evidence. Gate 2 remains awaiting approval and Gates 4–8 receive no pass.
regression_test: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/maintenance -p 'test_*.py' -v: 23 tests passed locally. Includes Ghost task mapping and retired-ID rejection tests. Both GitHub Actions workflows also completed successfully.
limitations: Workflow conclusions and run revision associations were checked; individual remote step logs were not independently audited. The push run directly identifies the tested branch revision. PR summaries identify the same head but the exact synthetic merge-checkout SHA was not retrieved. No Ghost runtime, newsletter delivery, production deployment, or policy approval was validated. Gate maintenance reported a non-failing Node.js action-runtime deprecation warning.
scope: g1-ci regression revalidation for the Ghost gate transition
observed_result: All 23 local maintenance tests passed for the committed change. Foundation checks succeeded on the branch push and PR, and Gate maintenance succeeded on the PR.
